95c740627ff4cdedc8f2c2705eb9eabbc7ed8d61vishnuroshanvishnuroshan4@gmail.comvishnuroshanvishnuroshan4@gmail.com17901038182026-09-23T00:33:38+05:3021da60ef5a63f90338372f5f97ee3ea2e4761ab3Rewrite resume content and generate the PDF from the siteRework the summary, work history, skills and projects for clarity and for
ATS parsing. Work history now leads with job titles and shows the Sedin
promotion; bullets name projects and technologies rather than restating
responsibilities. Skills move from a flat badge list into labelled groups.
The summary drops from 95 words to 37. Education gains locations and leads
with the degree. Dates use a single format and machine-readable time
elements.

Add a print stylesheet and scripts/build-resume-pdf.sh, which drives
headless Chrome to produce the resume from index.html and then verifies the
extracted text with pdftotext. Section headings map to ATS-standard names in
print through data-print-heading, so the page can keep its own wording.

Remove the phone number from the page, the worker and the example vars.

Allow challenges.cloudflare.com in connect-src. Turnstile could load its
script and its iframe but not complete its challenge request, which is why
the resume download failed.
